notes.title: Update notes for V0.9.9
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698405/2cf19d5d064418d0c727edde1c288ced6f822c7a.png
Another major update is live and we thank each and everyone for your support! There are many big and small changes in the game. During this change the goal was to achieve "fun instead of complexity".

After a long and hard work with a lot of trial and error, we decided to release an update that will capture the players' hearts. Feedback from the community and future outlook had a huge impact on the changes. Here are the list of changes in this update including the hotfixes following it...

Release notes includes changes from v0.9.0 until v0.9.9

 Mirror store got a new addition: BOOSTS!
 No more ingredients as resources
 New dynamic tutorial system
 Improved equipment and inventory
 More lively scenes with NPCs
 Order delivery remastered with new customers
 Introduced boss mechanic: The Gourmets
 Hotfixes include bug fixes and quality improvements


Please note that some of these changes are not yet available in the PC version of our game. For more info please check our Discord server.

notes.title: Update notes for v0.6.3 - hotfix #2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698405/d0137798d7d158c440db29b36ff0259f142c61d0.png

Change gameplay area bug fix: Fixed an issue where gameplay area could not be changed in some cases.

New customer cosmetics: Customers have new cosmetics such as clothes, hair, hat, etc.

Change truck bug fix: Minor issues related to buying and changing different trucks are resolved.

Several bug fixes and improvements to achieve overall stability of the game. In addition, implemented the backend base of the network part of the game.

notes.title: Update notes for v0.6.2 - hotfix
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698405/d0137798d7d158c440db29b36ff0259f142c61d0.png

Practice mode resource bug fix: Fixed an issue where resources could be used in practice mode.

Resource box transparency fix: Addressed a transparency issue with the resource box.

Equipment replacement optimization: Removed the dependency on the initial watch state when replacing equipment for truck layout.

Cooking sound effects update: Added and corrected some missing or incorrect cooking sound effects.

Customer order and recipe board enhancements: Improved the variety of customer orders and the functionality of recipe boards.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.5.1

notes.title: Grill on Wheels Milestone!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698405/e3c05bd4941b0fb6f4d4cde505b5e1e433d5276a.png
Hello everyone, sorry for keeping you waiting but it is going to be worth it! There are so many changes to mention but here is the highlights of this update:

• Introducing truck equipment upgrades!
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ There are new equipment now. You can buy upgraded ones from the market and put them in your truck. With the new inventory system, there is a limited number of equipment in your possession.

• With more equipment, comes more responsibilities...
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ New equipment can unlock new recipes for customers to order. Level 2 beverage counter opens two more drink types and optional ice for all drinks.

• Meats for all.
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ New double sized freezer can also hold your bacons and chickens. So, the customer might ask for burgers with those too.

• Curlies are fries too.
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ New double deep fryer sized can make curly fries, some customers might prefer those, no judgement.

• Get ready to dazzle your customers with sauced fries!
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ Craft your unique sauces by selecting ingredients, chopping them up, and blending them to perfection.

• Keeping your ingredients organized has never been easier.
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ Once you upgrade prep station, you'll experience a more efficient and tidy cooking area.

• The patient chef's choice!
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ Choose the Safe Grill and say goodbye to burnt dishes. This option ensures your ingredients never get overcooked, although it takes a bit more time.

• For the speedy gourmets!
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ Choose the Fast Grill to sizzle your dishes at lightning speed! It cooks your ingredients quickly, but keep a sharp eye – the risk of burning is higher.

• Go big or go home, just kidding. Size isn't everything...
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ If you've got the space, we've got the upgrades! Expand your culinary capabilities with larger equipment options.
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ Bigger equipment means more cooking power, allowing you to handle larger orders and more complex dishes with ease.
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ Tailor your kitchen to suit your cooking style – whether you're serving up small batches or large feasts, we've got the perfect size for you.

• Advertise Using Photos of Your Food Truck!
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ Elevate your marketing game by taking photos of your truck to use in your ads. Let your truck's unique style shine!
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ This feature allows you to capture the essence of your food truck, drawing in customers who are intrigued by its appearance.
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ Snap the perfect picture of your truck in action or in its most picturesque setting, and watch as more customers flock to your mobile culinary haven.

• Leaderboard is temporarily disabled. Multiplayer and network-related features are on our scope for the next big update. Nothing stands between us!

• Also, cosmetics are on its way! First of its kind is developer support pack with its main purpose is to help us continue developing the game and it includes some cosmetics. It will be implemented very soon.

• Other fixes, improvements and minor features are also arrived:
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ New and improved in-game menu UI.
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ With the new slicing feature, you can now continuously slice ingredients while holding in your hand.
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ Light indicators for deep fryer. You do not have to check whether the color of fries is changed or not. Green and red colored indicators let you know when to take the fries out.
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ Fixed all trucks (level 2, level 3, etc.)
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ You can use the tongs with all sliced food and its rotation is fixed.
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ Fixed feedback tool input texts not following the input.
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ Game's size on disk is reduced.
‎ ‎ ‎ ○ And many other performance optimization and minor bug fixes.

notes.title: UPDATE NOTES for v0.3 - Welcoming New "Grill on Wheel"ers
notes.content:
In this update, we have implemented numerous fundamental changes to add an all-rounded tutorial for newcomer Grill on Wheelers. 

Due to these extensive modifications, a fresh installation is now required for existing users. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause to our existing Grill on Wheel enjoyers. On the other hand, we are pleased to announce that we are actively working on a framework to prevent such occurrences in the future.
